problem_statement:
SUPER users created before 10.11 should retain READ_ONLY ADMIN privilege upon upgrade

MDEV-29596 removed {{READ_ONLY ADMIN}} privilege from the {{SUPER}} alias, so *new* users which are granted SUPER privilege won't get {{READ_ONLY ADMIN}} automatically. However, to maintain backward compatibility, the *old* users (created before the change) which have {{SUPER}} privilege shouldn't lose the {{READ_ONLY ADMIN}} capacity, so {{READ_ONLY ADMIN}} privilege should be granted to them upon upgrade.
